senses.sense_definition: The symbol (−) used to indicate subtraction or a negative value.

examples.text: The student forgot to write the <w>minus</w> before the number.

senses.sense_definition: To perform the mathematical operation of subtraction.

examples.text: He <w>minused</w> the expenses from the total revenue to find the profit.
